Mukhyamantri Bahin Sahayata Yojana

The scheme supports the economic independence, health and nutrition of women in Maharashtra by paying a monthly amount directly into the beneficiary's bank account.

Documents required

Applicants need proof of residence in Maharashtra, an income certificate of the family, and the bank account details of the applicant.

How to apply

Applications are submitted online on the scheme portal or at the anganwadi centre, where the anganwadi worker helps applicants fill in the form.
